mapper.select: SELECT sale_status FROM train_run WHERE id = #{runId} FOR UPDATE
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM train_stop s JOIN train_run r ON r.train_id = s.train_id WHERE r.id = #{runId}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM train_seat s JOIN train_coach c ON c.id = s.coach_id JOIN train_run r ON r.train_id = c.train_id WHERE r.id = #{runId}
mapper.insert: INSERT IGNORE INTO seat_segment_inventory (run_id, seat_id, segment_seq, status, created_at, updated_at) SELECT r.id, s.id, stop.stop_seq, 'AVAILABLE', NOW(), NOW() FROM train_run r JOIN train_coach c ON c.train_id = r.train_id JOIN train_seat s ON s.coach_id = c.id JOIN train_stop stop ON stop.train_id = r.train_id WHERE r.id = #{runId} AND stop.stop_seq < (SELECT MAX(last_stop.stop_seq) FROM train_stop last_stop WHERE last_stop.train_id = r.train_id)
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM seat_segment_inventory WHERE run_id = #{runId}
mapper.update: UPDATE train_run SET inventory_initialized = 1, inventory_initialized_at = NOW(), updated_at = NOW() WHERE id = #{runId}
mapper.select: SELECT st.id AS seat_type_id, st.code AS seat_type_code, st.name AS seat_type_name, COUNT(i.id) AS total_segment_count, SUM(i.status = 'AVAILABLE') AS available_segment_count, SUM(i.status = 'LOCKED') AS locked_segment_count, SUM(i.status = 'SOLD') AS sold_segment_count FROM seat_segment_inventory i JOIN train_seat s ON s.id = i.seat_id JOIN train_coach c ON c.id = s.coach_id JOIN seat_type st ON st.id = c.seat_type_id WHERE i.run_id = #{runId} GROUP BY st.id, st.code, st.name, st.sort_no ORDER BY st.sort_no
mapper.update: UPDATE seat_segment_inventory SET status = 'AVAILABLE', order_item_id = NULL, lock_expire_at = NULL, version = version + 1, updated_at = NOW() WHERE order_item_id = #{orderItemId} AND status = 'LOCKED'

UPDATE seat_segment_inventory inventory INNER JOIN order_item item ON item.id = inventory.order_item_id SET inventory.status = 'AVAILABLE', inventory.order_item_id = NULL, inventory.lock_expire_at = NULL, inventory.version = inventory.version + 1, inventory.updated_at = NOW() WHERE item.order_id = #{orderId} AND inventory.status = 'LOCKED'
UPDATE seat_segment_inventory SET status = 'SOLD', lock_expire_at = NULL, version = version + 1, updated_at = NOW() WHERE order_item_id = #{orderItemId} AND status = 'LOCKED'
UPDATE seat_segment_inventory SET status = 'AVAILABLE', order_item_id = NULL, lock_expire_at = NULL, version = version + 1, updated_at = NOW() WHERE order_item_id = #{orderItemId} AND status = 'SOLD'
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM seat_segment_inventory inventory JOIN order_item item ON item.id = inventory.order_item_id WHERE item.order_id = #{orderId} AND item.status = 'LOCKED' AND inventory.status = 'LOCKED'
mapper.update: UPDATE seat_segment_inventory inventory JOIN order_item item ON item.id = inventory.order_item_id SET inventory.status = 'SOLD', inventory.lock_expire_at = NULL, inventory.version = inventory.version + 1, inventory.updated_at = NOW() WHERE item.order_id = #{orderId} AND item.status = 'LOCKED' AND inventory.status = 'LOCKED'
